pretreatment: patterned by interferometric lithography and etched with a CHF3/Ar plasma to create 400×400 nm trenches, then the photoresist and any residual organics were removed by oxygen-plasma treatment
evidence: The mesoporous silica thin film samples were prepared on silicon substrates by evaporation-induced self-assembly. Prior to PA-ALD, the samples were patterned by interferometric lithography and etched with a CHF3/Ar plasma to create 400×400 nm trenches. Then the photoresist and any residual organics were removed by oxygen-plasma treatment.
